description: This satellite imagery displays a fragmented agricultural landscape in the northwest of Spain, showing a patchwork of fields and forest plantations. The image features varying land cover types, likely rendered in a false-colour composite. Lighter greenish and brownish areas represent cultivated fields or bare soil, while darker reddish, geometrically regular areas correspond to "Highly artificial coniferous plantations (Pine)". These plantations exhibit distinct rectangular and linear patterns, characteristic of managed monocultures for wood production. The image serves as an example of highly artificial coniferous plantations as defined in the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature. The image is credited to Eurostat, 2012, from the Land Use/Cover Area Frame Survey (LUCAS).
